comment: Class should be an easy A. Experience is very dependent on the group you are assigned to as you want to be able to split up work equally. If your group is decent the class should be fun and provide valuable presenting practice.

Not a super hard class, but for a .5 it is. Lot of group projects, which requires a meeting with the speech consultant and practice, and constant references to the textbook. Get ready to spend at least 2-3 hours outside of class weekly preparing for future assignments.

Professor Conn is very passionate about BUAD 205. For a half credit course this class was quite a bit of work. She is very accessible outside of class and if you send her assignments previous to their due date she will correct them for you which makes it very easy to get an A. There are many group projects and lots of public speaking.

I LOVED Dr. Conn. She is genuinely the sweetest human being and makes this class as interesting/engaging as it can be. Don't underestimate the value of this class - the things she teaches are actually very very helpful for post-grad job functions, especially if going into business. Take her if you can!

Prof. Conn is very energetic and tries to make a boring subject engaging. Her class is quite a bit of work each week, especially since it is only half a credit. As long as you do EXACTLY as her instructions say for the homework and presentation assignments, you will do well in the class. She is clear about what she expects and grades fairly.

I loved Dr. Conn! She is a tough grader (she won't give a necessarily bad grade but not an easy A) and at first her feedback may seem nit picky but TRUST she knows what she's talking about. In the end, you'll notice improvement in presenting skills as you WILL get comfy speaking in front of anyone. She's very enthusiastic and wants you to succeed!

Cindy Conn is nice and straight forward. If you follow her directions exactly you will get a good grade but if you don't do exactly what she wants on assignments you will lose points. There are 3 10min group presentations and writing assignments for homework. A lot of work for a .5 credit class but not very difficult. Just a boring class overall.

Dr. Conn is a nice lady who keeps the class as interesting as possible, but BUAD 205 is generally boring. There is a lot of work for a .5-credit class, but nothing too hard. You also have to meet with your group for presentations outside of class, so it can be time-consuming. Probably the best BCOMM professor, just not a great class overall.
I love professor Conn. Clear rubrics and so much enthusiasm radiating every class. Take her for Bcom!
Dr. Conn is very supportive both in and out of the class. I like her! Start the group presentations as soon as possible are the key to get an A.

Very boring and completely unessential class, but you have to take it unfortunately. Dr. Conn is really nice and atleast tries to keep it interesting. Don't slack on the big group projects, they are most of your grade.

I just did not enjoy BUAD 205. It's a class based on busy work, and it is not hard. Professor Conn is a nice woman, but the work feels more tedious than anything. Be sure to meet with your group, as most of the class surrounds 3 presentations with the same groupmates. You get 2 tries on most writing assignments. Listen to feedback!

Easy class to get the credit for the business major. A couple group presentations with the same group (that she picks) throughout the semester but they're easy to get through. No tests and not much reading.
